REVIANZ · Built for Digifianz

Projects, billing and profitability in one platform.

Cloudfianz built REVIANZ for Digifianz: a solution connecting project finances, billing and work with external collaborators.

Product

Visit revianz.com

Keep work and financial data connected

A Digifianz project can involve internal teams, specialists and other companies. Each contribution has services, periods, commercial terms and costs that affect the project's outcome.

The need was to support this model with a shared view: what was agreed with the client, who participates, delivery costs, what to bill and each project's margin.

The solution

The project as the starting point

REVIANZ brings this information together around each project. Services, assignments, commissions and billing terms form one operational record, tracked by period and supporting multiple currencies.

Understand margin as work is defined

As services and assignments are defined, the platform calculates associated amounts and costs. The profitability view shows the effect of those decisions before project activation and tracks trends by client, service or period.

The margin view links revenue and delivery costs to explain the project's outcome.

Take the agreement through to billing

Outgoing invoices are linked to the work being billed. Collaborator invoices are matched to expected services and amounts to review discrepancies and track approval and payment status.

Collaborate externally without losing context

A project can be shared with another organization. Each collaborator manages their contribution, assigns their team and proposes changes through a review workflow, retaining the link to the original project.

A shared basis for decisions.

Digifianz connects its teams' work with the financial management of each project.

  • Margin visibility

    Revenue, costs and profitability by project and period for decisions based on shared information.

  • Billing traceability

    Billed and outstanding amounts linked to work and its commercial terms.

  • Collaboration with context

    Teams and external companies coordinated on the same project with clear responsibilities.
